name: CHARLEMAGNE
description: Charlemagne is a trick-taking card game that involves tricks, trump, following suit. The game originated in Europe and has become popular worldwide.

content.text: Charlemagne is a trick-taking card game that involves tricks, trump, following suit. The game originated in Europe and has become popular worldwide.

Eastern Canada and Maine (USA). Euchre-based trick-taking; 4 players in fixed partnerships. Canadian form uses 34-card pack (Aâ€“7) plus two Jokers as top trumps; US form uses no Jokers, trump 9 as top. Single round of bidding; kitty of two cards.
4 players, two against two, partners opposite. Deal and play clockwise.
34-card pack: Aâ€“7 in all suits, plus two distinguishable Jokers (Canadian). US: no Jokers, trump 9 is top trump.
34-card pack + 2 Jokers (or 32-card no Jokers); score sheet.
8 cards each; dealer places 2 cards face down as kitty. Single round of bidding (left of dealer first, dealer last); bids must increase.
